steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hmm...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where is this...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're getting close to the coordinates that Frostleaf sent us, but...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What a disgusting smell.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's the stench of something burning...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where did Reunion lead us to?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Tsk! Watch out for the sneak attack!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Darn it...!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I... I missed?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Don't worry. We're safe here!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh-what's wrong?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Guh... urgh... aah...
He won't be able to answer you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Wh-what?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: From that building!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, is that...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Frostleaf! Frostleaf, is that you

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It is. I've taken care of the enemy.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Sorry for making you worry, Amiya.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you injured?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Medic, hurry!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No way... Why is your body all frostbitten? What happened to you...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Don't worry, it's minor.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Meteorite and Jessica are still in the main square.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: They should be safe for the time being, but it's hard to say how long that's going to last for.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I managed to lure the enemy out, so Reunion hasn't found them yet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The enemy?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Our cover hasn't been blown yet, so there's no need for concern yet.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: But, he's going to come soon...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Where are you hiding, little fox?

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Hurry and come out. Our game of hide and seek is about to come to an end.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: For every minute you stay hidden, I'll break another one of your friends' fingers--

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Do you still plan to keep running?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Mephisto...!)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (He's bluffing. Don't take the bait.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (What is he doing...)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Reunion is moving.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That little...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to get in touch with Meteorite...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why can't I get through? We've clearly already crossed the contaminated area...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Take a look at this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your communicator?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's... frozen over? Did it get... ruined by the frost?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Mephisto is a nobody.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: There's something wandering in this city...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...that is far more terrifying.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Something more terrifying?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The Yetis. If we run into them, we'll be in serious trouble.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yetis? Are you talking about the Yeti Squadron? What are they exactly...?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I don't have time to explain right now.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: But they are the ones... behind the sudden temperature drop, as well as our squads' injuries.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It seems like this squad has already established their territory within this city.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The sky is getting darker. This is a good opportunity for us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll be able to cross this open area more easily.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go rescue Meteorite and Jessica first.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I'll lead the way.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What are those things in the main square? I can't really see...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are they... statues of some sort? Their shapes are really strange...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And this smell makes me want to vomit...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Over here. Don't get separated.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Don't go look at those things...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: --We have company.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Let's take them out before they notice us.
